result.topic_en: Expansion of the Newtonian potential of a mass distribution in spherical harmonics (Legendre-type functions of the angle between two directions), with Laplace's equation in spherical coordinates (θ, φ, χ) and the associated orthogonality relations and ODE for the harmonic components.
result.transcription:
$V=\iiint\frac{\varrho' dx'}{\sqrt{1-2rr'\cos\gamma+r'^2}}=\sum\Omega_s r^s$, $\frac{\partial V}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial}{\partial x}\frac{\partial V}{\partial x}\ldots=-4\pi^2\varrho$, $\partial x=\partial\theta\cdot\sin\theta\partial\varphi\cdot\sin\theta\sin\varphi\partial\chi$ $\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-2rr'\cos\gamma+r'^2}}=\sum\Pi_s r^s$
[-$\frac{1}{1-2r\cos\gamma+\ldots}$-] $\frac{\partial(r^2\frac{\partial V}{\partial r})}{\partial r}\sin\theta^2\sin\varphi+r\sin\varphi\frac{\partial\sin\theta^2\frac{\partial V}{\partial\theta}}{\partial\theta}+r\frac{\partial\sin\varphi\frac{\partial V}{\partial\theta}}{\partial\varphi}+\frac{r}{\sin\varphi}\frac{\partial^2 V}{\partial\chi^2}=0$
$\cos\gamma=\cos\theta\cos\theta'+\sin\theta\cos\varphi\sin\theta'\cos\varphi'+\sin\theta\sin\varphi\sin\theta'\sin\varphi'\cos(\chi-\chi')$ $\int\Omega_s\Phi_t\partial x=0$
$4\pi\varrho=\sum(2s+2)\Omega_s$ $\int\Omega_s\Pi_s\partial x=\frac{4\pi^2}{2s+2}\Omega'_s$
$\Pi_s=\sum\cos\gamma^{s-2m}\frac{s-m!}{m!\,s-2m!}(-1)^m 2^{s-2m}=\frac{\sin(s+1)\gamma}{\sin\gamma}$
$\Omega_s=\sum_{n=0}^{n=s}\Pi_{s,n}X_n$ $\frac{\partial\sin\theta^2\frac{\partial\Pi_{s,n}}{\partial\theta}}{\partial\theta}+(s(s+2)\sin\theta^2-n(n+1))\Pi_{s,n}=0$

methods.what: Expansion of the potential/reciprocal distance kernel in a power series of r with harmonic coefficients
Addition formula for the cosine of the angle between two directions
Orthogonality of harmonics of different degree
Reproducing property of the zonal harmonic kernel
Density expressed through the harmonic components
Explicit formula for the zonal function (Chebyshev polynomial of the second kind)
Decomposition of a harmonic into lower harmonics and the ODE for the coefficient functions
